- WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA standard

## Accessibility Audit Cost

Accessible.org web accessibility audits cost $100 – $250 per page (or screen) and $25 – $100 for light pages/screens. Our audits follow best practices for ADA and EAA compliance. Our audit price is based on comprehensive manual evaluation using the WCAG 2.1 AA standard (or WCAG 2.2 AA). Audits are conducted in desktop environment with the client option to add mobile.

Our website accessibility audits are fully manual, formal evaluations conducted by technical accessibility experts who evaluate your website or other digital assets against WCAG 2.0 AA, WCAG 2.1 AA, or WCAG 2.2 AA standards.

Scope typically does not include all pages or screens, but rather a representative sample.

We use an automated scan as a review to ensure all issues correctly identified by a scan are included in our final audit report.

All Accessible.org auditors are certified DHS Trusted Testers. The DHS Trusted Tester Process is a manual test approach that aligns with the ICT Testing Baseline, and provides repeatable and reliable conformance test results.

### Digital Assets Audited

Accessible.org can audit all types of digital assets:

- Websites

- Web pages

- Web apps

- Mobile apps

- Platforms

- Dashboards

- Software

- Games

- Widgets

- Elements

- Components

- Portals

- Multimedia Players

### Evaluation Methodology

Accessible.org uses the following methodologies and environments when evaluating your digital asset(s):

- Screen Reader Testing

- Keyboard Testing

- Visual Inspection

- Code Inspection

- Automated Scan:

- AXE

- Color Contrast Analyzer Tool

- Browser Zoom:

- 200%

- 400%

- Assistive Technologies:

- Screen Readers: NVDA, JAWS, and/or VoiceOver.

- Browser Environments:

- Browsers: Chrome and Safari.

- Operating Systems:

- Windows (desktop)

- iOS (mobile)

- Device Environments:

- Audit includes desktop environment with client option to add mobile (iPhone).

By choosing our audit services, you will receive an excellent quality, easy to understand audit report that your team can take action on.

We can add other environments (e.g., MacOS and Android) upon request for an additional fee.

Our website accessibility audit cost breakdown shows you exactly how we determine your final audit price quote.

### Deliverables:

- Technical Audit Report Format: Excel Spreadsheet

- Includes detailed technical findings and specific issues identified during the audit

### Price

$100–$250 per page or screen, $25-$100 for light pages/screens

## VPAT / ACR

VPAT services start at $350 for the WCAG VPAT version. We will fill in and complete a Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) and create a detailed Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on our audit. Our ACR creation service is $350 (for the WCAG version) in addition to the price of the audit for your digital asset.

### Other VPAT Editions

- Section 508: $550

- EN 301 549: $650

- INT: $950

This documentation is essential for meeting procurement requirements. We can pause issuance so that your team has a chance to fix issues and we can validate. This results in a cleaner ACR (demonstrating a more accessible product or service) you can deliver to clients.

### Price:

$350 for the WCAG VPAT version.

## Technical Support

Our technical support hours are flexible and can be used for validation of fixes (to ensure the audit issues have been resolved).

Technical support also includes support for any accessibility or implementation questions your team has.

### Support Includes:

- Validation

- Questions Answered

### Price

$195/hour

## Accessibility User Testing Cost

User testing services for website accessibility (and other digital assets) cost $550 per session and are a best practice for ADA compliance. The price of user testing is discounted if you choose Accessible.org for audit and remediation services.

User testing is conducted by an accessibility professional with a disability, is an essential part of ensuring your digital assets are accessible to all users. We offer user testing at a discounted rate when combined with our audit and remediation services.

### Service Details:

- User Testing: Conducted by a professional who is blind or visually impaired, using screen reader assistive technology to evaluate your website or digital asset.

- Deliverable: You will receive a recording of the user testing session upon completion.

### Deliverables:

- Recording of the user testing session upon completion.

- User Testing Attestation

Note : User testing sessions include up to 10 pages or screens with a time duration cap of 30 minutes.

### Price

$550 per session

$450 per session if you choose us for audit services.

### Accessibility Remediation Cost

We will remediate your digital asset at the code level. This means we will fix the technically complex accessibility issues on your website, web app, or mobile app.

To be eligible for remediation, we must 1) audit your digital asset and 2) have full code access. The audit is necessary to ensure we know all accessibility issues that exist (we don’t accept outside audits to uphold quality). Full code access is necessary to ensure we’re able to make all fixes.

We validate our remediation.

#### Service Details:

- Remediation: Conducted by a technical accessibility expert with development experience. All fixed issues are reviewed and validated by auditor.

- Deliverable: You will receive your code remediated digital asset.

#### Remediation Includes:

- Technical code remediation

- Validation of remediation

Note: An audit and full code access is required for remediation.

### Price

$750 – $4,500 for most clients, $100 – $450 per page or screen, depending on volume and complexity.

## Document Remediation Cost

Document accessibility remediation costs start at $4.00 per page. The price of remediating PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets for WCAG 2.1 AA conformance depends on the document status and project scope.

We will remediate your documents to meet the highest accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 / 2.2 AA and PDF/UA standards. Documents include:

- Microsoft PowerPoint documents

- PDFs

- Microsoft Word documents

- Microsoft Excel spreadsheets

- Canva documents

We will manually test documents and fix accessibility issues according to WCAG 2.1 AA and WCAG 2.2 AA standards and PDF/UA. Each document will meet Section 508 criteria, pass the Adobe Acrobat accessibility check, and be individually tested with screen reader assistive technology.

Minimum order is $250.

### Deliverables

- Documents remediated for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA, PDF/UA conformance and/or Section 508 compliance, passing Adobe Acrobat and assistive technology checks.

- PAC Report for PDFs (where applicable)

### Price

- PDFs start at $4.00/page

- Word Documents start at $7.00/page

- PowerPoints starts at $7.00/page

## Accessibility Certification

Our website accessibility certification documents are provided free of charge ($0.00) as a result of our services. These documents include Accessible.org certification, user testing certification, and a statement of conformance.

Note that to be eligible for a statement of conformance or provider certification, your website or other digital asset must be fully WCAG conformant.

For a statement of partial conformance, your website must be fully WCAG conformant other than content that is outside of your control.

### Certification Includes:

- Statement of conformance

- Statement of partial conformance

- Accessible.org certification

- User testing certification

### Price

$0.00

We will remediate content for WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, the highest accessibility standard for web content (exceeds WCAG 2.1 AA). This follows best practices for ADA compliance.

### Accessibility Project Planning

Our digital accessibility and ADA compliance project planning services cost $1,500 and up. Our pricing is custom to your project size and the cost includes an organized and structured approach tailored to reaching your accessibility objectives.

Accessible.org can help you with planning and organizing your accessibility project, offering a streamlined service that eliminates the need to hire or train employees who may lack specialized knowledge. We begin by closely collaborating with clients to understand their specific requirements and objectives. This enables us to develop detailed project plans that outline each necessary step, from initial audits to final implementation, including clear timelines and milestones.

Based on client input, we also draft applicable documentation including accessibility statement, accessibility policy, procurement policy, and project roles and responsibilities. By leveraging our expertise, clients can avoid the expense and inefficiency of hiring or training internal staff, resulting in a well-executed project where digital assets meets or exceeds accessibility standards.

The following project prices provide a range so you can estimate the cost of your project.

Small Projects: $1,500 to $3,500.

Kris brings 7 years of accessibility and compliance experience to every session. Kris has worked with hundreds of clients from Fortune 500 companies to local governments to small businesses. Kris’s insight and strategy can help your organization save hundreds of hours of time and hundreds of thousands of dollars.

Our technical experts have years of experience in accessibility and can provide the immediate answers and knowledge your team is looking for.

## What Your Accessibility Audit Price Covers

- ### $500 Quick Audit

 Up to 5 page templates, automated and manual spot checks, and a top-10 issues report mapped to WCAG 2.2. Best for small sites that need a first baseline.

- ### $2,000 Complete Audit

 Up to 25 templates or key user flows, full manual testing in JAWS, NVDA and VoiceOver, a re-test of fixed issues and an accessibility statement draft.

- ### Fixed Price, Agreed In Writing

 No hourly billing. The price is agreed before work starts, and the same packages cover WCAG 2.2, ADA, Section 508 and EN 301 549.

- ### Not Sure Yet? Talk First

 The free 30-minute call is for scoping and a quote. The $100 hour is a technical session: an audit walkthrough, time with your developer or a live site review.

 Cost Factors

## What Changes the Cost of an Accessibility Audit

- ### Templates and user flows, not URL count

 A large blog built on a handful of templates can cost less to audit than a small web app with sign-up, search, checkout and a dashboard.

- ### Interactive components

 Carts, filters, modals, date pickers, chat widgets and third-party embeds need keyboard and screen reader testing. Most blockers hide here, so the Complete Audit covers them with JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver and keyboard-only passes.

- ### The standard you have to meet

 ADA Title II points to WCAG 2.1 AA, Section 508 to WCAG 2.0 AA and the EAA to EN 301 549. The same packages cover every standard.

- ### Documents and PDFs

 PDFs, Word and PowerPoint files are tested separately from web pages, including NVDA screen reader passes. PDF remediation is quoted after scoping.

- ### Procurement paperwork

 A VPAT or Accessibility Conformance Report is quoted on top of the audit, because every criterion has to be documented.

- ### Fixes and re-tests

 Fixing issues is a separate, quoted piece of work, done by your team or ours. The Complete Audit includes a re-test of fixed issues so you leave with evidence.

 Worth The Cost?

## Accessibility Audit vs Lawsuit Costs and Free Scans

### Is an Accessibility Audit Cheaper Than an ADA Lawsuit?

Lawsuit Risk At A Glance

- 2,045ADA website accessibility lawsuits filed in U.S. courts from January to June 2026, up 1.54% on a year earlierSource: [EcomBack 2026 mid-year report](https://www.ecomback.com/ada-website-lawsuits-recap-report/2026-mid-year-ada-website-lawsuit-report)

- 24.25%Share of those lawsuits (496) filed against sites that already had an accessibility widget installedSource: [EcomBack 2026 mid-year report](https://www.ecomback.com/ada-website-lawsuits-recap-report/2026-mid-year-ada-website-lawsuit-report)

- $1MPaid by overlay vendor accessiBe under a 2025 FTC order over claims its widget could make any site WCAG compliantSource: [FTC press release, April 2025](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/04/ftc-approves-final-order-requiring-accessibe-pay-1-million)

For most sites, yes, by a wide margin. Defense, settlements, experts and remediation after a demand letter routinely cost far more than a planned audit, and a widget is not a defense. Our fixed packages ($500 Quick, $2,000 Complete, $2,000 [Shopify Accessibility Audit](https://halfaccessible.com/service/shopify-accessibility-audit/)) give you a documented WCAG 2.2 baseline before lawyers or buyers ask. Already received a letter? See [ADA lawsuit remediation](https://halfaccessible.com/ada-lawsuit-remediation/). For market ranges and lawsuit context, see our [accessibility audit cost guide](https://halfaccessible.com/accessibility-audit-cost/) and [ADA website lawsuit statistics 2026](https://halfaccessible.com/ada-website-lawsuit-statistics-2026/).

### Why a Free Scan Is Not the Same as an Audit

We run automated checkers in every audit, but the [W3C Web Accessibility Initiative](https://www.w3.org/WAI/test-evaluate/tools/selecting/) is clear that evaluation tools “can not determine accessibility, they can only assist in doing so.” That manual work is what you pay for.

## Frequently Asked Questions

 How do you decide between the Quick Audit and Complete Audit?

 We scope the work first — pages, templates, components — and recommend the [Quick Accessibility Audit](https://halfaccessible.com/service/low-cost-accessibility-audit/) ($500, up to 5 templates) when a small marketing site needs a clear top-10 issues list, or the [Complete Accessibility Audit](https://halfaccessible.com/service/accessibility-audit-services/) ($2,000, up to 25 templates or key flows) when checkout, dashboards or multi-step journeys need full keyboard and screen reader coverage. Not sure yet? Book a [free 30-minute call](https://calendly.com/shadab-halfaccessible/instant-meeting-schedule) to talk it through; if you already have a scan or another vendor’s report and need a live technical review, book the [$100 one-hour consultation](https://halfaccessible.com/book-a-consultation/).

 What does each package cost?

 Your first conversation is a [free 30-minute call](https://calendly.com/shadab-halfaccessible/instant-meeting-schedule) to talk through where you stand, scope a project and get a quote. The [1-Hour Consultation](https://halfaccessible.com/book-a-consultation/) is $100, a technical working session to walk through an audit, talk with a developer or review issues live. The Quick Audit is $500 for small marketing sites with up to 5 representative pages. The Complete Audit is $2,000 and covers larger or more complex sites, including full [Shopify storefront and checkout](https://halfaccessible.com/service/shopify-accessibility-audit/) coverage, or a [WordPress Accessibility Audit](https://halfaccessible.com/service/wordpress-accessibility-audit/) for themes and builders. Need a standalone [VPAT/ACR](https://halfaccessible.com/service/vpat-acr-documentation/) or PDF remediation? Ask when we scope — those are available as add-ons. Web apps with unusual interaction patterns may need a custom quote. We will tell you the number before you commit.

 Is there a minimum engagement?

 No ongoing contract is required. You can start with a single Quick Audit if that is what you need. Some clients keep us on for re-audits after each release, or move from audit into remediation and monitoring; that is optional, not a lock-in.

In addition, we do not allow companion books based on copyrighted works (e.g., summaries, study guides, etc.) to be published outside the U.S. without written permission from the copyright holder.

### Offensive content

We don’t sell certain content including content that we determine is hate speech, promotes the abuse or sexual exploitation of children, contains pornography, glorifies rape or pedophilia, advocates terrorism, or other material we deem inappropriate or offensive.

### Artificial intelligence (AI) content (text, images, or translations)

We require you to inform us of AI-generated content (text, images, or translations) when you publish a new book or make edits to and republish an existing book through KDP. AI-generated images include cover and interior images and artwork. You are not required to disclose AI-assisted content. We distinguish between AI-generated and AI-assisted content as follows:

- AI-generated: We define AI-generated content as text, images, or translations created by an AI-based tool. If you used an AI-based tool to create the actual content (whether text, images, or translations), it is considered "AI-generated," even if you applied substantial edits afterwards.

- AI-assisted: If you created the content yourself, and used AI-based tools to edit, refine, error-check, or otherwise improve that content (whether text or images), then it is considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” Similarly, if you used an AI-based tool to brainstorm and generate ideas, but ultimately created the text or images yourself, this is also considered "AI-assisted" and not “AI-generated.” It is not necessary to inform us of the use of such tools or processes.

### What is Adobe Firefly?

 Adobe Firefly is an AI-powered creative studio that helps you create and edit images, videos, audio, and vector graphics from simple text prompts.
